entries.title: Your library starts in the add box
entries.body: When you open your library on a computer, the cursor now waits in the box for adding an article rather than in the search box, so you can paste an address straight away. If you arrive with a search already filled in, nothing moves the cursor.

entries.title: Bibliographies catch works cited by author and year
entries.body: The Bibliography in the Sources panel could miss works the article cites by author and year. A bibliography made or remade after this release adds them from the article's own text, marked "found in the text" and without a description. Works listed this way no longer turn up under Not cited as though the article had left them out.

entries.title: Cited by works for more arXiv papers
entries.body: For some articles from arXiv, Cited by in the Sources panel showed none of the papers citing them, because the details we held for the article were incomplete and could not confirm it was the same paper. It now checks against the title and authors arXiv publishes for it, so those citing papers appear.
